abi_differential.role: exact integer delta for every object present in both arms

abi_landed.role: widths read from the landed codec and relation crate

source.commit_subject: OrderPage v4: derived-rank ids, tombstones, per-order expiry, streaming writer
source.note: One codec owner. Every width below is that file's own account_len, account_version and Intent::encoded_len expression restated term by term, so the harness re-derives each total instead of quoting it, and `abi-audit` re-derives them again from the file on disk. Digests are the blobs at the pinned commit, not a mutable working tree. The relation bounds come from crates/clutch-batch and are not re-derived by the audit: their blob digests are checked instead, so a moved relation blob is drift until someone re-verifies the bounds by hand.

layout_hypothesis.role: original design sketch, retained unchanged for falsification history

landed_abi_source.commit_subject: OrderPage v4: derived-rank ids, tombstones, per-order expiry, streaming writer
landed_abi_source.note: One codec owner. Every width below is that file's own account_len, account_version and Intent::encoded_len expression restated term by term, so the harness re-derives each total instead of quoting it, and `abi-audit` re-derives them again from the file on disk. Digests are the blobs at the pinned commit, not a mutable working tree. The relation bounds come from crates/clutch-batch and are not re-derived by the audit: their blob digests are checked instead, so a moved relation blob is drift until someone re-verifies the bounds by hand.
